integrity: The proof uses the exact source formulas for the sharp constant, the maximizing parameter, and the affine relation K=(1+k)/(1-k). The substitution u=K^{-1/2} converts the endpoint square root into an ordinary Taylor expansion. The resulting coefficients were replayed through the source critical-point equation and exact constant formula; numerical checks are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: The result analyzes the high-distortion endpoint of the exact sharp pre-Schwarzian constant proved in the cited source. It does not improve the fixed-parameter sharp constant, make a new small-dilatation claim, or assert uniqueness of all extremizing harmonic realizations.
title: Square-root saturation of the affine-balanced pre-Schwarzian shadow
